verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's own Wally CLI runs a small model on the local machine offline and without an account (docs-6, docs-14). Its docs also say one command points a tool at a model and starts it (docs-7), and the CLI itself is confirmed in the release repo (probe-3). However, nothing shows a persistent local model server or a documented stop or shutdown command, and the OpenAI-compatible endpoint (docs-4) is documented for the hosted cloud API, not a local server. missing for 10: documented local server start/serve command, explicit stop/shutdown command, local endpoint details, hands-on corroboration.
